observation.command: cd /workspace && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U yii2_user -d yii2_db -tAc "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='backendusers' AND column_name IN ('username','email');" && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U yii2_user -d yii2_db -tAc "SELECT * FROM backendusers LIMIT 1;" | cut -c1-120 && SWAGPASS=$(grep '^SWAGGER_HTTP_AUTH_PASSWORD=' .env | cut -d= -f2-) && echo "--- swagger with admin credentials ---" && docker exec yii2_vue_dash_container curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" --max-time 15 -u "admin:${SWAGPASS}" http://127.0.0.1/administration/docs/ && echo "--- api measurements endpoint (no credentials, expect 4xx not 404) ---" && docker exec yii2_vue_dash_container curl -sS -o /tmp/api_resp.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" --max-time 15 -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}' http://127.0.0.1/api/v1/node/measurements && head -c 300 /tmp/api_resp.txt
